# Adding Your DCK$ TOOLS Logo

## Quick Setup

1. Save your pink and blue dripping logo as: `public/logo.png`
2. The app will automatically display it in the header

## File Requirements

- **Format**: PNG (with transparent background recommended)
- **Size**: 512x512px or larger (will be displayed at ~64px height)
- **Location**: `/public/logo.png`

## Current Logo

The app is currently set to load from: `/logo.png`

If the logo file doesn't exist, the app will gracefully hide the image element and just show the text "DCK$ TOOLS" with gradient styling.
